summary.en: The big word: its letters spring in on 1/32 notes and its weight swings 780 → 200 → 800 → 430 on the beats; the full stop is the line colour.
summary.zh: 大字：字母按三十二分音符依次弹入，字重在拍点上 780 → 200 → 800 → 430 摆动；句号是线色。

fits: The hook of a reel: the brief's one-word answer.
notFor: A word over seven letters (four Chinese characters); a sentence.

intent.en: Answer the brief in one word and make the beat visible in its weight.
intent.zh: 用一个词回答需求，让节拍在字重上看得见。

content.en: One word of 4–7 letters and an optional full stop.

fits.zh: 作品集的钩子：需求的一个词的回答。

notFor.zh: 超过四个汉字的词；整句话。

pairs.note: its first four glyphs become the swatches

en: The palette takes the first four glyph boxes: a word under four letters breaks the hand-off.
zh: 配色环节取前四个字形框：少于四个字，交接就断了。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
